about.title: About Me
about.name: Kenichi
about.intro:
I'm Kenichi, a blue cat who enjoys coding and photography lives in Taiwan. 
This site is where I collect things I make and share a bit about myself — from artwork to photos and everyday life. I enjoy building small things you can find on my GitHub, and taking photos when I spot cute furries. 
Nice to meet you, hope you have a good time here.

consentModal.title: Cookie Notice
consentModal.description: This site uses cookies to ensure essential functionality and to improve your browsing experience. You can manage your preferences at any time.

sections.title: Cookie Usage
sections.description: This site uses cookies and similar technologies to provide essential functionality and to understand how visitors interact with the content. You can control which categories are active below.

sections.title: Strictly Necessary
sections.description: These cookies are required for the site to function correctly and cannot be disabled. They do not collect any personally identifiable information.

body.name: cc_cookie
body.description: Stores your cookie consent preferences so you are not prompted again.

body.name: __cf_bm / _cfuvid / __cfruid
body.description: Cloudflare infrastructure cookies for security, bot mitigation, and rate limiting.

sections.title: Personalization
sections.description: These cookies allow the site to remember your preferences — such as your chosen language and display theme — so they persist across visits.

body.name: preferred-locale
body.description: Stores your preferred display language. If disabled, language selections will not persist between sessions.

body.name: theme (localStorage)
body.description: Stores your preferred color scheme (light or dark mode). Cleared when personalization is disabled.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.description: These cookies help understand how visitors use the site. The data is aggregated and used solely to improve content and performance.

body.name: _ga / _ga_*
body.description: Google Analytics — identifies unique visitors and aggregates usage statistics.

body.name: _clck / _clsk / CLID / ANONCHK / MR / SM
body.description: Microsoft Clarity — records anonymized session data for heatmaps and session replays.

body.name: MUID / _EDGE_V / SRCHD / SRCHUID / SRCHUSR / SRM_B / USRLOC / _RwBf / _Rwho / _SS
body.description: Microsoft/Bing auxiliary cookies set by Clarity for cross-site deduplication and user insights.

body.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
body.description: Cookieless Real User Monitoring (RUM) — measures Core Web Vitals and page load performance. No personal data is stored.
